title: 第519章 不敬业的黑白无常第518章 都是剧本
content_zh:
时间转瞬即逝，一眨眼，三天就过去了。
临近傍晚，夕阳的余晖洒在上清观的院子里，将青石板镀上一层淡淡的金红色。
林道然依旧像条咸鱼一样，躺在他的专属躺椅上。
躺椅是知秋一叶用藤条编的，摇摇晃晃，吱呀作响。
林道然双手垂在两边，双腿交叠，一晃一晃地活动着手脚，“努力修炼”着。
旁边，许仙像根木头一样站立着，他身着一袭白色长衫，长衫上还沾着些许泥土和草屑，显然是好几天没换了。
他的脸上，此时写满了纠结之色，那表情，像是吃了黄连的哑巴，有苦说不出。
没错，许仙活了！
没等白素贞把仙草拿回来，他就活了！
至于怎么活的？
当然是林道然救活的呗！
端午晚上，白素贞离开之后，小青还想遵循白素贞的吩咐，来给林道然他们斟茶倒酒。
然而，还没等她靠近，就被林道然挥手拒绝了。
“青蛇，我跟七爷八爷有点私事要聊......”
他伸出右手，在空中挥了挥，如驱赶苍蝇一般。
“你就不用待在这里了，回你的保安堂去吧！”
“嗖～”
话落，一道金色法力，从他的手上飞出，落在小青身上！
小青一个恍惚，只觉得天旋地转，身形瞬间消失在院子里！
等回过神来，已经是在院门外了。

“砰～”
院门在她身后重重关上！
小青顿时心急如焚，她伸出双手，拼命拍打着院门，发出“咚咚咚～”的声响。
“开门！”
“让我进去！”
“姐夫还在里面！”
然而，院门纹丝不动，连一丝回应都没有。
她也不敢强行推门进去，害怕惹怒了林道然和黑白无常，到时候误了事，无法救活姐夫！
片刻之后，小青还是离开了。
因为她想着，进不去，那自己在院子外看总行了吧。
然而，当她伸长了脖子，越过栅栏朝里面看去，映入眼帘的，却是一片空旷的院子，连个人影都看不见。
只有那张破旧的躺椅，在月色下轻轻摇晃。
“这是......”
小青瞳孔骤缩，瞬间明白过来。
这是林道然施法了，不想让她看到里面的情况，于是将整座上清观屏蔽起来。
外人朝里面看去，只能看到一座空无一人的院子，和大门紧闭的道观。
“该死......”
小青咬了咬牙，恨恨地跺了跺脚，但终究无可奈何，只能垂头丧气地走了。
院子内，林道然和七爷八爷，已经拿着酒坛开始拼酒了。
七爷将自己的长舌头一收，便提着酒坛，往自己的嘴里灌酒！

那舌头原本垂到胸口，惨白而细长，此刻却卷成一团，塞回了嘴里。
“咕噜咕噜咕噜～”
酒液如瀑布般倾泻而下，顺着他的喉咙流入腹中。
content_en:
Time flies, in the blink of an eye, three days pass.
As evening approaches, the afterglow of the setting sun shines on the courtyard of Shangqingguan, coating the bluestone with a light golden red.
Lin Daoran was still lying on his exclusive lounge chair like a salted fish.
The lounge chair was made of rattan by Zhiqiu Yiye. It was rickety and creaking.
Lin Daoran hung his hands on both sides, crossed his legs, and moved his hands and feet in a flash, "cultivating hard".
Next to him, Xu Xian stood like a piece of wood. He was wearing a white gown. There was still some dirt and grass clippings on the gown. It was obvious that he hadn't changed it for several days.
His face was full of confusion at this time, and his expression was like a mute who had eaten Coptis chinensis and was unable to express his suffering.
That's right, Xu Xian is alive!
Before Bai Suzhen could get the jelly grass back, he was alive!
As for how to live?
Of course it was Lin Daoran who saved him!
On the Dragon Boat Festival evening, after Bai Suzhen left, Xiaoqing still wanted to follow Bai Suzhen's instructions and pour tea and wine for Lin Daoran and the others.
However, before she could get closer, she was rejected by Lin Daoran with a wave of her hand.
"Green Snake, I have something private to discuss with the seventh and eighth masters..."
He stretched out his right hand and waved it in the air, as if to ward off flies.
"You don't have to stay here anymore, go back to your security hall!"
"Whoosh~"
As soon as he finished speaking, a golden mana flew out from his hand and landed on Xiao Qing!
Xiaoqing was in a trance, feeling like the world was spinning, and her body disappeared in the yard instantly!
When he came to his senses, he was already outside the courtyard gate.
"Bang~"
The courtyard door slammed shut behind her!
Xiaoqing was suddenly anxious. She stretched out her hands and slapped the courtyard door desperately, making a "dong dong dong~" sound.
"Open the door!"
"Let me in!"
"Brother-in-law is still inside!"
However, the courtyard door did not move at all, and there was not even a trace of response.
She didn't dare to push the door open for fear of angering Lin Daoran and Hei Bai Wuchang, and then she would be unable to save her brother-in-law!
After a while, Xiaoqing left.
Because she thought, if she couldn't get in, she would just look at the head office outside the yard.
However, when she stretched her neck and looked inside over the fence, she saw an empty yard with not even a single person in sight.
Only the worn-out deck chair swayed gently in the moonlight.
"This is..."
Xiaoqing's pupils shrank suddenly and she understood instantly.
This was Lin Daoran's casting. He didn't want her to see what was going on inside, so he shielded the entire Shangqing Temple.
When outsiders look inside, they can only see an empty courtyard and a Taoist temple with a closed door.
"Damn..."
Xiaoqing gritted his teeth and stamped his feet bitterly, but in the end he had no choice but to walk away dejectedly.
In the yard, Lin Daoran and the seventh and eighth masters were already holding wine jars and starting to fight for wine.
Master Qi put away his long tongue, then picked up the wine jar and poured wine into his mouth!
The tongue originally hung down to his chest, pale and slender, but now it was rolled up into a ball and stuffed back into his mouth.
"Gulu gulu gulu~"
The wine poured down like a waterfall, down his throat and into his belly.
